title: Linear form on the Boolean cube
statement: Let $a_1,\ldots,a_n\in\mathbb{R}$ and let $x=(x_1,\ldots,x_n)\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The linear form with coefficients $a_i$ evaluated at $x$ is $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$.
